title: Data set and resources
goal: Run the actual DCS processor for two of your own requests: verify two rows totaling 75 minutes, then one filtered row of 45 minutes.
prerequisites: onec.p8; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
sections: DCS means Data Composition System (СКД, система компоновки данных). It separates the description of available data, report settings and execution. Think of a report as a question: which records should it include, what should one row mean and which quantities should it total? Answer these questions before opening the designer. A resource is a value aggregated by the chosen rule; here Минуты is a duration in minutes.

The supplied complete module creates two requests belonging to your own customer, with durations of 30 and 45 minutes. It builds a DataCompositionSchema and outputs a collection containing document reference, customer and minutes. Before running it, predict two rows and a total of 75. The customer-reference filter isolates this experiment from earlier work in the infobase.

An already customer-grouped dataset can be summed again only with correct multiplicity. A bad join doubles resources before DCS. Check raw query rows before report groupings. A computed field with a nice name cannot repair lost or extra records.

Follow the pipeline in order: the schema describes the query and fields; settings select fields and filters; the layout composer prepares the execution layout; the DCS processor executes it; the output processor returns a value table. DataPath (ПутьКДанным) names the field available to the composition system. Creating a schema object alone does not execute a report.
Settings differ from the source set

One schema can support multiple report variants. Users change available fields, filters and groupings without silently gaining forbidden data scope. Check permissions and dataset restrictions separately. Preserve variant and parameters so another reviewer reproduces the same question.

This experiment returns detail rows only, without an extra total row. Sum their Минуты values once: 30 + 45 = 75. If you later add grouping and report totals, distinguish detail from aggregate rows so you do not add the same minutes twice. The shorthand 2/75 below means two rows totaling 75 minutes.

A separate three-document example illustrates grouping: durations 30 and 45 for one customer and 15 for another give 90 minutes overall and customer totals 75 and 15. This is a different input from the two-document runnable experiment. In both cases compare actual document references as well as totals. A matching sum can conceal a missing record and an extra record of the same duration.

Recompose the same input with minutes>30: expect only the second reference/45. Changing the threshold to 45 yields no rows and distinguishes semantics despite valid syntax. Retain settings, source and both outputs.
